meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 处理 git 相关请求时，会先获取仓库状态、日志和分支信息，判断提交信息风格，并按文件目录或功能把改动拆成多个原子提交；同时支持 rebase/squash 和历史查找（如 blame、log -S）。
howto.when: 当你说到 “commit”、“rebase” 等关键词，或问“谁写的”“什么时候加的”这类历史问题时触发。

say.text: 把这些改动按原子提交拆开再提交
say.note: 会先输出提交计划再执行

say.text: 把最后三个提交压缩成一个
查一下这段代码是哪个提交加的

howto.what_en: Once installed, when Claude handles git requests, it first gathers repo status, logs, and branch info, detects the commit message style, and splits changes into multiple atomic commits by directory or concern; it also supports rebase/squash and history search (e.g., blame, log -S).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'commit' or 'rebase', or ask who wrote a piece of code or when a change was added.

say_en.text: Split and commit these changes as atomic commits.
Squash the last three commits into one.
Find which commit added this line.
